overviewDescription: ⚠️ The specific model code 'SJFPJQ' could not be verified against any manufacturer catalog. This appears to be a factory/OEM-specific code for a high-speed dial (rotary) linking machine — a common category of Chinese-manufactured knitwear linking equipment. Typical specifications for this machine class: linking speed ≈300–1,200 rpm (adjustable, servo-motor controlled on modern units); gauge range commonly 3G–18G (needles per inch, model-dependent); dial diameter commonly 14" (356 mm) on standard units; small energy-saving servo motor (20–90 W typical); single-line linking, 1–4 layers; self-contained oil reservoir (multi-day natural oiling on many models). Recommendation: confirm gauge, dial diameter, and rated RPM directly from the machine's nameplate, as 'linking' machines are usually customized per knitting gauge at time of order.
